who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113
where: blaze prove, the plan of a theorem with no proof file (crates/hir-ty-lean/src/plan.rs)
what: `blaze prove -p blaze-core --json` said of a new theorem `Open: there is no proof file` and I copied its 40 emitted models into lean/BlazeModel and committed them. Two did not compile: `lake build BlazeModel` then said `World/allows.lean:119:6: Redundant alternative` and `World/lands.lean:37:6: Unknown constant ...lands.loop_0`. The models were on the landing branch, whose Lean build I ran only after the smoke.
cost: one more landing round (a revert on the landing branch, a release build, a smoke, two proves: about 12 minutes), and a proof lane started against models two of which do not build
cause: a theorem with no proof file is answered Open before Lean has seen its models, so an Open answer says nothing about whether the translator emitted Lean that compiles; and copying models into the tree runs no Lean
whys: the models were refused by Lean only at the full build: nothing compiled them when they were emitted
blaze prove stops at `no proof file` before the step that compiles the model
the plan treats compiling the model as part of checking the proof, so with no proof there is nothing to do
an Open answer therefore mixes two states: the model is fine and waits for a proof; the model is broken and no proof could be written
class: an answer that is reached before the check that would contradict it has run: a status that skips a step and does not say so
prevention: blaze prove compiles a theorem`s model whether or not a proof file exists, and answers `the generated model does not build: a bug in blaze`s translator` with Lean`s error in place of Open; not built (the translator lane holds plan.rs today). Until then: `leanvm.sh <wt> <lane> 4.35.0 build BlazeModel` on copied models before committing them (added to H-proof-loop`s recipe in words here)
workaround: run `lake build BlazeModel` on the models copied from a run before checking them in
fix: blaze prove compiles every theorem`s model whether or not a proof file exists and answers `model broken` (ProofRecord::ModelBroken, schema 61) with Lean`s first error where it does not build; by the lane provemodel (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-14
